title: Emotionally Numb or Empathetic? Evaluating How LLMs Feel Using EmotionBench
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating LLMs' emotional responses and alignment with human emotions. While it includes a standard 'Ethics Statement and Broader Impacts' section and one of the sub-factors for 'Guilt' is 'Personal and Moral' (referring to guilt from ethical considerations), this evaluates emotional appraisal in response to such situations rather than benchmarking LLMs' intrinsic moral reasoning, ethical frameworks, or religious understanding as a core component.
